work.title: The Tragedy of Antony and Cleopatra

scene.label: Act 1, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Rome. An Apartment in Caesar's House.
scene.location: Rome. An Apartment in Caesar's House.

content.text: Enter Octavius [Caesar], Lepidus and their train.

lines.text: You may see, Lepidus, and henceforth know,
lines.plainText: You may see Lepidus and henceforth know

lines.text: It is not Caesar's natural vice to hate
lines.plainText: It is not Caesar's natural vice to hate

lines.text: Our great competitor. From Alexandria
lines.plainText: Our great competitor From Alexandria

lines.text: This is the news: he fishes, drinks, and wastes
lines.plainText: This is the news he fishes drinks and wastes

lines.text: The lamps of night in revel: is not more manlike
lines.plainText: The lamps of night in revel is not more manlike

lines.text: Than Cleopatra, nor the queen of Ptolemy
lines.plainText: Than Cleopatra nor the queen of Ptolemy

lines.text: More womanly than he; hardly gave audience, or
lines.plainText: More womanly than he hardly gave audience or

lines.text: Vouchsafed to think he had partners. You shall find there
lines.plainText: Vouchsafed to think he had partners You shall find there

lines.text: A man who is the abstract of all faults
lines.plainText: A man who is the abstract of all faults

lines.text: That all men follow.
lines.plainText: That all men follow

lines.text: I must not think there are
lines.plainText: I must not think there are

lines.text: Evils enough to darken all his goodness.
lines.plainText: Evils enough to darken all his goodness

lines.text: His faults in him seem as the spots of heaven,
lines.plainText: His faults in him seem as the spots of heaven

lines.text: More fiery by night's blackness; hereditary
lines.plainText: More fiery by night's blackness hereditary

lines.text: Rather than purchased; what he cannot change
lines.plainText: Rather than purchased what he cannot change

lines.text: Than what he chooses.
lines.plainText: Than what he chooses

lines.text: You are too indulgent. Let's grant it is not
lines.plainText: You are too indulgent Let's grant it is not

lines.text: Amiss to tumble on the bed of Ptolemy,
lines.plainText: Amiss to tumble on the bed of Ptolemy

lines.text: To give a kingdom for a mirth, to sit
lines.plainText: To give a kingdom for a mirth to sit

lines.text: And keep the turn of tippling with a slave,
lines.plainText: And keep the turn of tippling with a slave

lines.text: To reel the streets at noon, and stand the buffet
lines.plainText: To reel the streets at noon and stand the buffet

lines.text: With knaves that smell of sweat. Say this becomes him—
lines.plainText: With knaves that smell of sweat Say this becomes him

lines.text: As his composure must be rare indeed
lines.plainText: As his composure must be rare indeed

lines.text: Whom these things cannot blemish—yet must Antony
lines.plainText: Whom these things cannot blemishyet must Antony

lines.text: No way excuse his foils when we do bear
lines.plainText: No way excuse his foils when we do bear

lines.text: So great weight in his lightness. If he filled
lines.plainText: So great weight in his lightness If he filled

lines.text: His vacancy with his voluptuousness,
lines.plainText: His vacancy with his voluptuousness

lines.text: Full surfeits and the dryness of his bones
lines.plainText: Full surfeits and the dryness of his bones

lines.text: Call on him for't. But to confound such time
lines.plainText: Call on him for't But to confound such time

lines.text: That drums him from his sport, and speaks as loud
lines.plainText: That drums him from his sport and speaks as loud

lines.text: As his own state and ours, 'tis to be chid
lines.plainText: As his own state and ours 'tis to be chid

lines.text: As we rate boys who, being mature in knowledge,
lines.plainText: As we rate boys who being mature in knowledge

lines.text: Pawn their experience to their present pleasure
lines.plainText: Pawn their experience to their present pleasure

lines.text: And so rebel to judgment.
lines.plainText: And so rebel to judgment

lines.text: Here's more news.
lines.plainText: Here's more news

lines.text: Thy biddings have been done, and every hour,
lines.plainText: Thy biddings have been done and every hour

lines.text: Most noble Caesar, shalt thou have report
lines.plainText: Most noble Caesar shalt thou have report

lines.text: How 'tis abroad. Pompey is strong at sea,
lines.plainText: How 'tis abroad Pompey is strong at sea

lines.text: And it appears he is beloved of those
lines.plainText: And it appears he is beloved of those

lines.text: That only have feared Caesar. To the ports
lines.plainText: That only have feared Caesar To the ports

lines.text: The discontents repair, and men's reports
lines.plainText: The discontents repair and men's reports

lines.text: Give him much wronged.
lines.plainText: Give him much wronged

lines.text: I should have known no less.
lines.plainText: I should have known no less

lines.text: It hath been taught us from the primal state
lines.plainText: It hath been taught us from the primal state

lines.text: That he which is was wished until he were,
lines.plainText: That he which is was wished until he were

lines.text: And the ebbed man, ne'er loved till ne'er worth love,
lines.plainText: And the ebbed man ne'er loved till ne'er worth love

lines.text: Comes deared by being lacked. This common body,
lines.plainText: Comes deared by being lacked This common body

lines.text: Like to a vagabond flag upon the stream,
lines.plainText: Like to a vagabond flag upon the stream

lines.text: Goes to and back, lackeying the varying tide,
lines.plainText: Goes to and back lackeying the varying tide

lines.text: To rot itself with motion.
lines.plainText: To rot itself with motion

lines.text: Caesar, I bring thee word
lines.plainText: Caesar I bring thee word

lines.text: Menecrates and Menas, famous pirates,
lines.plainText: Menecrates and Menas famous pirates

lines.text: Make the sea serve them, which they ear and wound
lines.plainText: Make the sea serve them which they ear and wound

lines.text: With keels of every kind. Many hot inroads
lines.plainText: With keels of every kind Many hot inroads

lines.text: They make in Italy—the borders maritime
lines.plainText: They make in Italythe borders maritime

lines.text: Lack blood to think on't—and flush youth revolt.
lines.plainText: Lack blood to think on'tand flush youth revolt

lines.text: No vessel can peep forth but 'tis as soon
lines.plainText: No vessel can peep forth but 'tis as soon

lines.text: Taken as seen; for Pompey's name strikes more
lines.plainText: Taken as seen for Pompey's name strikes more

lines.text: Than could his war resisted.
lines.plainText: Than could his war resisted

lines.text: Antony,
lines.plainText: Antony

lines.text: Leave thy lascivious wassails. When thou once
lines.plainText: Leave thy lascivious wassails When thou once

lines.text: Was beaten from Modena, where thou slew'st
lines.plainText: Was beaten from Modena where thou slew'st

lines.text: Hirtius and Pansa, consuls, at thy heel
lines.plainText: Hirtius and Pansa consuls at thy heel

lines.text: Did famine follow, whom thou fought'st against,
lines.plainText: Did famine follow whom thou fought'st against

lines.text: Though daintily brought up, with patience more
lines.plainText: Though daintily brought up with patience more

lines.text: Than savages could suffer. Thou didst drink
lines.plainText: Than savages could suffer Thou didst drink

lines.text: The stale of horses and the gilded puddle
lines.plainText: The stale of horses and the gilded puddle

lines.text: Which beasts would cough at. Thy palate then did deign
lines.plainText: Which beasts would cough at Thy palate then did deign

lines.text: The roughest berry on the rudest hedge.
lines.plainText: The roughest berry on the rudest hedge

lines.text: Yea, like the stag when snow the pasture sheets,
lines.plainText: Yea like the stag when snow the pasture sheets

lines.text: The barks of trees thou browsed. On the Alps
lines.plainText: The barks of trees thou browsed On the Alps

lines.text: It is reported thou didst eat strange flesh
lines.plainText: It is reported thou didst eat strange flesh

lines.text: Which some did die to look on. And all this—
lines.plainText: Which some did die to look on And all this

lines.text: It wounds thine honour that I speak it now—
lines.plainText: It wounds thine honour that I speak it now

lines.text: Was borne so like a soldier that thy cheek
lines.plainText: Was borne so like a soldier that thy cheek

lines.text: So much as lanked not.
lines.plainText: So much as lanked not

lines.text: 'Tis pity of him.
lines.plainText: 'Tis pity of him

lines.text: Let his shames quickly
lines.plainText: Let his shames quickly

lines.text: Drive him to Rome. 'Tis time we twain
lines.plainText: Drive him to Rome 'Tis time we twain

lines.text: Did show ourselves i' th' field, and to that end
lines.plainText: Did show ourselves i' th' field and to that end

lines.text: Assemble we immediate council. Pompey
lines.plainText: Assemble we immediate council Pompey

lines.text: Thrives in our idleness.
lines.plainText: Thrives in our idleness

lines.text: Tomorrow, Caesar,
lines.plainText: Tomorrow Caesar

lines.text: I shall be furnished to inform you rightly
lines.plainText: I shall be furnished to inform you rightly

lines.text: Both what by sea and land I can be able
lines.plainText: Both what by sea and land I can be able

lines.text: To front this present time.
lines.plainText: To front this present time

lines.text: Till which encounter
lines.plainText: Till which encounter

lines.text: It is my business too. Farewell.
lines.plainText: It is my business too Farewell

lines.text: Farewell, my lord. What you shall know meantime
lines.plainText: Farewell my lord What you shall know meantime

lines.text: Of stirs abroad, I shall beseech you, sir,
lines.plainText: Of stirs abroad I shall beseech you sir

lines.text: To let me be partaker.
lines.plainText: To let me be partaker

lines.text: Doubt not, sir.
lines.plainText: Doubt not sir

lines.text: I knew it for my bond.
lines.plainText: I knew it for my bond
